project_name: Pilgangoora Lithium-Tantalum Project site power station (BOO)
selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout). Full ASX trail from DFS (power station planned as contractor-operated) through mining proposal approval to the 7-year BOO site power contract awarded to Contract Power Group (11 Sep 2017). Contract Power is the same supplier as in the Wodgina and Karlawinda cases.

lead_time.note: Target (ASX 11/09/2017 12:48 +10:00) minus the DFS release (s1/s2, ASX 20/09/2016 09:15 +10:00) = 356.1 days. The DFS only says the power station will be contractor-operated, with no tender or supplier identified; the target's 'final contract award' implies earlier preferred-supplier steps that were not located, so the interval is a project-stage gap, not a tender-to-award gap. ASX times were read by the agent from the ASX listing and not captured.

blockers: Earlier preferred-supplier / tender announcements for the power contract (the target says 'final contract award') not located.

target_fit_note: Seven-year build-own-operate site power contract (dual fuel, solar-hybrid provision) awarded to an IPP for a long-life lithium project: long-term on-site supply, not temporary or rental power. The text says a 'final' award was issued, so earlier preferred-supplier steps exist but were not located.
